performance_case.causal_mechanism: An independently declared absent-or-inactive carry state prevents an inferred verifier result from hiding unexpected installation drift or missing future capability before a bounded forward carry source is considered.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This slice proves only an explicit wrapper/verifier contract, focused offline tests and later one bounded Manager-run server verification. It cannot prove installation, source execution, registration, carry evidence, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading value.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero because no strategy, source or Trading runtime state changes. Any future path-risk benefit remains contingent on prospective evidence and a separately preregistered matched-capital experiment.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Without an explicit carry expectation, a seemingly green verifier can conceal either unauthorized extra capability or a missing inactive installation, delaying or corrupting the later carry evidence decision. The four-file gate is cheaper than discovering that ambiguity after R2 finishes.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted total PnL is unchanged; the infrastructure value is reducing false verification confidence and learning latency before a future carry-conditioned DRA mechanism can be accepted or rejected.
